cause.en: The request body format is invalid.

user_fix.en: Fix the body using the hints in the error message and the API reference.
user_fix.id: Perbaiki body sesuai petunjuk di pesan error dan referensi API.

operator_fix.en: Validate JSON and required fields before sending.
operator_fix.id: Validasi JSON dan field wajib sebelum mengirim.

cause.en: Authentication failed because the API key is wrong.
cause.id: Autentikasi gagal karena API key salah.

user_fix.en: Check the API key, or create one if you do not have it yet.
user_fix.id: Cek API key, atau buat key baru kalau belum punya.

operator_fix.en: Rotate the key in your secret store and redeploy.
operator_fix.id: Ganti key di penyimpanan rahasia lalu deploy ulang.

cause.en: The account balance has run out.

user_fix.en: Check the account balance and top up. Retrying before that keeps failing.
user_fix.id: Cek saldo akun lalu isi ulang. Retry sebelum itu akan terus gagal.

operator_fix.en: Alert on low balance and stop retries on 402.
operator_fix.id: Pasang peringatan saldo rendah dan hentikan retry untuk 402.

cause.id: Request berisi parameter yang tidak valid.

user_fix.en: Change the parameters named in the error message and check the API reference.
user_fix.id: Ubah parameter yang disebut di pesan error dan cek referensi API.

operator_fix.en: Strip parameters that the target model does not support before sending.
operator_fix.id: Buang parameter yang tidak didukung model tujuan sebelum mengirim.

cause.en: Requests are sent too quickly, or a concurrency or QPS limit was exceeded.
cause.id: Request dikirim terlalu cepat, atau batas paralel atau QPS terlampaui.

user_fix.en: Pace requests and retry with backoff.
user_fix.id: Atur jeda antar request dan ulangi dengan backoff.

operator_fix.en: Check the per-model limits on the rate-limit page and cap concurrency.
operator_fix.id: Cek batas per model di halaman rate limit dan batasi jumlah paralel.

cause.en: The server is overloaded because of high traffic.

user_fix.en: Retry after a short wait with backoff.
user_fix.id: Ulangi setelah jeda singkat dengan backoff.

operator_fix.en: Cap retries and consider a fallback model during peaks.
operator_fix.id: Batasi retry dan pertimbangkan model cadangan saat jam sibuk.
